successAnalysis.summary: The unified MVP succeeded because spatial content was moved into one canonical scene/layout contract and style-specific rendering was restricted to interpretation rather than placement.
reusableLesson: Do not build three visually similar scenes; build one canonical scene and three adapters.
Preserve KRIEGER as the spatial/lighting quality baseline.
Reuse mature shared systems: Living Watercolor 3D for INK and World Block Factory / voxel pipeline for CUBE.
User-visible graphics acceptance must sit above technical gates; technical PASS alone was insufficient in the failed version.
Cross-style improvements should originate in shared geometry, camera, layout, lighting intent and semantics.
